RAT.Settings.opacity.Name: Ghost opacity (%)
RAT.Settings.opacity.Hint: 30–80%; default 50%. Higher values make ghosts more visible.
RAT.Settings.labels.Name: Ghost caption
RAT.Settings.labels.Hint: The name and elapsed-round counter allowed by the GM. High contrast uses white text on an opaque dark backing. Unavailable names remain unknown.
RAT.Unsupported: Probably Just a Rat: observation was suspended because the required Foundry VTT 14 canvas API is unavailable.
RAT.Token.Label: Position memory
RAT.Token.Hint: Hostile tokens are remembered by default. Overrides still require visual detection and never reveal unseen tokens.
RAT.Clear.Name: Forget all positions
RAT.Clear.Hint: Clear only this client's memory. No key is assigned by default.
RAT.OpacityMigrationFailed: Could not update the opacity setting format. Set a value from 30 to 80% manually.
RAT.CacheUnavailable: Could not save local position memory. Ghosts still work, but may disappear after reloading.
RAT.Settings.sharePings.Name: Ghost ping audience
RAT.Settings.sharePings.Hint: For all players: choose whether remembered-position pings are visible only to the sender or to everyone. Supports Shift/Alt.
RAT.PingFailed: Could not display the remembered-position ping.
RAT.Settings.showNames.Name: Show ghost names
RAT.Settings.showNames.Hint: For all players: show the names of previously observed tokens. Off leaves the position label or round counter. Secret-disposition names stay hidden from players.
RAT.CaptionMigrationFailed: Could not migrate the caption setting. Select standard, high contrast or off manually.
RAT.Settings.grayscale.Name: Grayscale (%)
RAT.Settings.grayscale.Hint: Default 30%. 0% preserves original colors; 100% makes the frozen image fully grayscale. Opacity is adjusted separately.
RAT.Settings.showRounds.Name: Show rounds since disappearance
RAT.Settings.showRounds.Hint: For all players: show the number of elapsed combat rounds since the target left sight. Off shows only the last-position label.
RAT.Settings.outline.Name: Silhouette outline
RAT.Settings.outline.Hint: Add a thin contrasting outline around the frozen silhouette. Off by default.
RAT.Settings.outlineColor.Name: Outline color
RAT.Controls.Title: Ghost memory
RAT.Controls.ActionFailed: Could not perform the ghost-memory action.
RAT.Settings.memoryRounds.Name: Ghost lifetime in combat (rounds)
RAT.Settings.memoryRounds.Hint: For all players: rounds since loss of sight before a ghost disappears. Positive whole number; default 2. Changes apply to existing memories.
RAT.Settings.memoryMinutes.Name: Ghost lifetime outside combat (minutes)
RAT.Settings.memoryMinutes.Hint: For all players: real minutes since loss of sight before a ghost disappears. Positive number; default 1. Changes apply to existing memories.
RAT.Settings.combatOnly.Name: Ghosts only in combat
RAT.Settings.combatOnly.Hint: For all players: remember positions only during a started combat in the current scene (or a global combat). Outside combat, memory is cleared. Off by default.
